rules.text: SikaPlast® 3-in-1 E is ideal for the following applications: As a true neutral set Water Reducing admixture used in combination with Accelerators, Retarders and Air Entrainers to produce a wide range of products and strengths, while maintaining the ability to accommodate fluctuations in temperature and set time requirements
rules.heading: USES

rules.text: True neutral set characteristics, which makes Sika- Plast® 3-in-1 E ideal for use as an all year round admixture and in combination with set retarders and accelerators.
rules.heading: FEATURES
